[quote=neue_republik;61049215][spoiler=[b]Back on the warpath[/b]][b]The Chancellor of the Second Hochdeutsche Republic (12:55 WST)[/b]

[i]"My fellow citizens. 

At this hour the armed forces of the Republic and the coalition are in the opening stages of military operations to defend Erene from urgent danger. The objective of the Republic in this war is clear: remove the terrorist regime in its entirety, obtain the arrest of all those involved in state-sponsored attacks against civilians and ensure that another attack will be pre-emptively thwarted. Above all the Republic will not tolerate a mass attack against civilians, especially against an ally of the Republic. 

By my orders and after consultation with the National Security Council, the Defense Forces have been directed to begin striking military targets to undermine the regime's ability to carry out further attacks. The efforts of the Republic will be decisive and broad to restore international security and defend the world from state-sponsored terrorism. 

May God bless our country and those who defend her."[/i]

[b]War post:[/b] 

[i]The Neue Republik had begun building up its military presence in southern Vespurias beginning with the Daesunite findings on the ties of the Dutch State to the attacks. Via the Armee and Luftwaffes strategic airlift aircraft and chartered commercial aircraft thousands of Republik troops had been brought into the theater. The navy, especially the merchant marine, helped to deliver equipment and supplies to staging grounds in Imerria. Using Blackwell Naval Base in Lionsheart, trucks, howitzers, ammunition, fuel and heavy armor would pour into the country through roll-on/roll-off ships. Fuel bladders established across Imerria would help to continually sustain the presence of Republik vehicles. St. Marks AFB would receive the Luftwaffes JA-35s, J-22s, aerial refuelers, reconnaissance aircraft and more. Two carrier strike groups and multiple ARGs would be pulled by the Hochdeutsche Navy into southern Vespurian waters to begin naval operations against the Dutch State. 

Over the weeks Republik River Joint reconnaissance aircraft had maintained a constant surveillance over the Dutch order of battle. Using multiple antennas the aircraft track the emissions of enemy early warning radar, fire control radar and other systems to help guide kinetic and EW strikes. Additionally, the River Joints maintain constant surveillance over enemy communications to monitor troop movements and asset allocations to assist the Republiks operations. Using saturated aperture radar, the HDF is able to see through enemy camouflage by using microwaves to penetrate opaque materials to help identify Dutch command centers, arms depots, assets and air defense systems. Electro-optical satellites continuously scan the Dutch State to provide live information to commanders and track the movements of the enemy. For closer-range aerial surveillance the RQ-170 stealth UAV is used to provide information. Its radar absorbent material, flying wing shape and shielded engine inlet all work together to limit its radar cross-section and IR detection. Using passive surveillance such as electro-optical imaging, IR sensors and SIGINT the RQ-170 provides even more information for the HDF to more accurately cripple the Dutch States military. 

Using the information provided by reconnaissance, the Hochdeutsche Navy would begin strikes against the Dutch. The Donau-Klasse submarine would quickly come up to shallow waters to fire off a salvo of 154 cruise missiles to strike airfields, command centers and aviation fuel stores to degrade the Dutch ability to challenge Republik air superiority. In the opening stages of the war, the Republik would push for a strategy of using high-speed hypersonics to work to bypass the enemies air defense. Using Hyperschallsystem launchers located in Imerria, several Deutsche Adler missiles are fired toward the most critical pieces of a Dutch defense: long-range early warning radar for the integrated air defense system, national command centers, missile launch systems and airfields. With a cruise speed of mach 12 and terminal phase maneuvering the Adler hypersonic missiles would work to bypass air defenses by pushing response times to the absolute limit. Air launched ballistic missiles fired from the J-16s also pursue high level naval targets while traveling at mach 10 including destroyers and carriers. However, the bulk of the initial air assault would still not be over. Rapid dragon cells, missile cells dropped from the cargo aircraft of the Republik would be deployed within Imerrian airspace and used to strike the Dutch State. Armed with the family of affordable mass missiles and allowing for 48 missiles per cargo aircraft the FAMM allows the Republik to flood Dutch airspace with hundreds of relatively cheap cruise missiles to pursue a twin saturation attack alongside the hypersonic assault. With a broad target set including airfields, aviation fuel, transportation infrastructure used for military purposes, command centers, arms depots and bases the LCAS drones join in the saturation attacks. 

Fourth generation J-15E and J-15EX fighter jets would be pulled relatively farther away from the fighting. Maintaining their distance to reduce the effectiveness of Dutch anti-air capabilities their two-seater configuration helps to allow them to command their respective AJ-11 collaborative combat aircraft. Managing up to four CCAs per J-15, the use of their loyal wingmen allows the jets to not only reduce risk posed to themselves but also present a greater force multiplier. Should the Dutch activate their radar to defend against the incoming salvo the CCAs would respond almost immediately. Firing off their REG-3000 anti-radiation missiles from up to 120 miles away at before visual range, the REG-3000s continuously track the emissions of the radar used by the Dutch air defenses. Their extremely small airframe and warhead help to lower their radar cross-section immensely while their passive tracking systems remove any links that missile warning systems can track. Additionally, should the Dutch turn off their radars to avoid being hit, the REG-3000s lock on the last known location while using the latest emissions to extrapolate target movement. At the same time, MALD drones are deployed from underneath J-16s and sent into Dutch airspace. Mimicking the radar signature of Republik aircraft the MALDs work to bait the air defense system into firing while also working to jam Dutch communications with the onboard EW suite. The EA-18G Growler would be deployed by the Hocheutsche-Klasse aircraft carrier as well. One of its electronic warfare pods helps to jam lower-frequency early warning radar while the other jams high-frequency fire control radar to disrupt the guidance systems of enemy missiles and interceptors. Additionally, the ALQ-84 EW pod allows the EA-18G to spoof enemy radar to create false targets while also being able to broadcast a burst of microwave energy to permanently destroy Dutch military electronic systems. The 360 degree coverage helps the EA-18G fleet to maintain constant EW disruption of Dutch forces by allowing them to jam, spoof and destroy while heading into and exiting the fight. To further attack Dutch forces the JA-35 fifth generation aircraft fire off CHAMP missiles from their internal weapons bays with each of the missiles emitting powerful EMPs to wreck Dutch electronics. Finally, from onboard the Hochdeutsche ships, Harpy loitering munitions are fired into Dutch territory. Tracking electronic emissions the drones autonomously move until reaching critical radar systems and then diving down onto them with its warhead. 

At sea the HDF continues to drive forward the offensive. The Navy from its Hochseeflotte-Klasse destroyers fire off salvos of their LRASMs. The radar absorbent material coating, sea skimming, maneuverability and high speed all work towards penetrating the enemy fleet's air defences. From the JA-35s further ALBMs are fired at mach 10 towards the most significant naval targets, using their terminal maneuvering and high speed to help prevent interception. ARGs in the area, using their established advanced expeditionary bases, use their NMESIS systems to fire off sea-skimming NSMs towards the enemy fleet while the MAS-L systems fire their supersonic PrSM ballistic missiles. Ray UUVs under the waters, aided by the powerful sonar towed arrays of the Sternbild-Klasse frigates use their ATT torpedoes to intercept enemy submarines while also laying mines across the seabed. On the surface the B-25EX stealth bombers using the 500-lb variant of the QUICKSINK JDAM move to provide further bombardment of the Dutch fleet. With the ability to engage up to 80 targets at once, hundreds of QUICKSINKs are dropped onto the dutch fleet with the bombs exploding near the hull to maximize breach potential.[/i][/spoiler]
